\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  10 & 10 & 10 \\
  10 & 60 & 10 \\
  10 & 10 & 10
\end{bmatrix}, \qquad L_4 \star W = 10 + 10 + 10 + 10 - 4 \cdot 60 = -200
\]

The center is brighter than its neighbors, so the negative-center Laplacian is negative. The output mapping turns -200 into a pixel value:

| Mapping | Pixel value |
|---|---|
| Absolute value | 200 |
| Offset by 128 | 0 |
| Clip to 0 to 255 | 0 |
